name: Shinnyuu Seiboshin Arya ~Seiboshin sura Inchuu Bounyuu Kaizou Seme de Dametsu Suru!
original_name: 神乳聖母神アーリャ～聖母神すら淫蟲膨乳改造責めで堕滅するっ!
source:
Nadja won't stop until she has conquered heaven, earth and hell.
She captured Anemone, the holy saint of Eternia, and betrayed Kallen, the onetime queen of Hell, and long ago broke their souls and bodies in the dark pits of sexual slavery.
They surrendered their reigns, and Nadja now controls hell and earth.
All that remains is the matriarch, Holy Goddess Arya. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE122624.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
纳佳立誓征服天界、人界与地狱，绝不会停下脚步。
她俘获了伊特尼亚的圣女阿涅莫涅，又背叛了昔日的地狱女王卡莲，早已在黑暗的性奴役深渊中摧毁了她们的身心。
她们拱手交出王权，如今纳佳已统治地狱与人间。
她最后的目标只剩下母神阿莉娅。

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE122624.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
